description: Tell HorseToga a job went wrong. A person reviews every dispute. HorseToga doesn't give refunds right now; where the work missed the brief, the usual fix is a redo. One open dispute per job. The same as POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/disputes.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

reason.description: What went wrong, in at least 10 characters.
